root_cause.text: In the ntfs_compress_write function, when processing a sparse cluster (lcn == SPARSE_LCN), the computed `valid` value may not advance beyond the current `ni->i_valid` due to corruption, causing the loop `while (valid < pos)` to spin indefinitely.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (ni->i_valid == valid)` before updating `ni->i_valid` to prevent the infinite loop, and the commit description explicitly states that if the retrieved valid value is always the same, it triggers an infinite loop. The syzbot report shows a hung task blocked in `ntfs_file_write_iter`.
